top.description: Player 1 background (Ichigo + Rukia). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
top.prompt: A stunning 2D anime illustration in the classic Bleach cel-shaded style, square format 1:1. A single continuous, seamless, and unified landscape of the traditional tiled rooftops of Seireitei under a warm orange dusk sky, spanning the entire width. On the left side of this same landscape stands Ichigo Kurosaki in black Shinigami robes, resting his massive black Zangetsu sword on his shoulder, surrounded by a dark red and black spiritual pressure aura. On the right side of this same landscape stands Rukia Kuchiki in black Shinigami robes, holding her white katana Sode no Shirayuki, surrounded by a swirling white frost and ice crystal aura. Both characters are naturally integrated into the same single-picture scenery and are drawn slightly smaller to fit entirely within the frame with a safe margin from the outer edges. The center of the rooftops is empty and clean. No split screen, no vertical dividers, no black bars, no empty black columns, no black panels. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, cropped characters, split screen, black bars, vertical dividers, black columns, black panels

loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Ichigo vs Aizen jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A humorous and epic 2D anime scene of a card match in the classic Bleach style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Ichigo Kurosaki (Shinigami robes) and Sosuke Aizen (white Hueco Mundo outfit) are seated properly and facing each other across a stone table in the ruins of Las Noches, playing a game of Magic. Ichigo is concentrated and sweating over a hand of cards, while Aizen smirks condescendingly. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table, a detailed Magic: The Gathering card layout is displayed: rows of fantasy cards with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degrees to indicate they are tapped, and a small glowing black and red energy orb. Moonlit night sky visible through ruined stone arches in the background. Vibrant cel-shading. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
